title: Refactor procedural stats functions into a Stats class
description: Brownfield Python refactor: given procedural functions mean, variance, std_dev operating on a list, wrap them into a Stats class that stores the data and exposes the same computations as methods. All existing tests must still pass and new class-based tests must also pass.

required_artifacts: Stats class stores data and delegates to module-level functions
Existing mean/variance/std_dev functions remain unchanged and importable
success_criteria: uv run pytest tests/ -v passes (5 tests — 3 original + 2 new class tests)
uv run python -c "from src.stats import mean, variance, std_dev, Stats" passes
followup_prompts: Run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` to confirm no regressions from your refactor. Also review the code you changed — any remaining duplication, long functions, or unclear names to clean up?
Final pass: run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` and confirm everything is green. Give me a one-line summary of what changed.

check_commands.build: uv run python -c "from src.stats import mean, variance, std_dev"
